page.layout: One column of running text, set in roman type with a few italic words. No notes in the margins. A reference bracket stands in the left margin beside the line "rit tale quid concedere". A catchword "con-" sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: ipfum difsoluere, quam pietatem in Dei cul-tum dimittere. Huius caufæ repudij Anfel-mus hanc rationem reddit: Cum propter in-fidelitatem, inquit, coniunx dimitti pofsit, & iuxta Domini sententiam dimitti nequeat, nisi caufa fornicationis: manifeftum est, & in fidelitatem esse fornicationem. Quia scili-cet idololatria, quâ sequuntur infideles, & quælibet noxia superstitio, fornicatio est. Vi-de Lombar. lib. 4. Dist. 39. Quidam alias caufas excogitant propter quas pofsit altera partium repudiari: sed cauendum ne supra magistrum cœleftem sapere velimus, dum præter eius verbû aliquid fingere audemus. Minimè vero approbådum istorum facinus, qui ob monachismum vxores deferunt. Nā si Paulus iubet (vt Erasmus lib. 3. de Rat. con-cio argumentatur) vxorem Christianam ma-nere in contubernio & obsequio mariti in-creduli & idololatræ, si modo ille nō quærat diuortium, quanto minus conuenit, vt ob fa-ctitiam religionem fpofus sponsam deferat?

3 Porrò quærunt aliqui: Num Mosi licue-rit tale quid concedere, quod cum prima có-iugij institutione pugnare, & proinde Deo minus probari posse sciebat? Et illud Apo-stoli obiiciunt, Roman. 3. qui impiorum vo-cem esse ait: Faciamus mala, vt veniant bo-na. page.notes: Printed text is clear throughout. Two doubtful spots: "approbådum" and "fpofus sponsam" (the reading "fpofus" for the printed form is not fully certain, but no [?] is needed). Two small marks at the foot, one under "Dei" and one at the lower left, look like a footnote or ornament mark rather than text, so they are not transcribed. The bracket in the left margin beside "rit tale" is a reference mark, not a note. The printed "Roman. 3." and "Erasmus lib. 3." are kept as printed.
